evidence.quote: Whenever the secret value in a secret changes, Secrets Manager requests a new data key from AWS KMS to protect it.
evidence.title: Secret encryption and decryption in AWS Secrets Manager

evidence.quote: Secrets Manager does not use the KMS key to encrypt the secret value directly. Instead, it uses the KMS key to generate and encrypt a 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) symmetric data key, and uses the data key to encrypt the secret value.
